prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Layout changes to path selection stages were helpful and significantly improved conversion.
Interactive walkthrough redesigns, new adoption flows, and sign-in reassurance hints significantly hurt conversion.
Reordering steps, copy changes, wait-time info, photo upload guidance, and sign-in card layout changes showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently too high for walkthrough redesigns, new flows, reassurance hints, copy changes, and reordering.
Predictions were too low for path selection layout changes, underestimating their actual positive impact.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -15.6% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -0.3% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +6.3% over 2 test(s)
- finish, copy: +0.5% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -12.4% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: -1.2% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -5.4% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, layout: +1.7% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -0.1% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.5%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Stage Layout Redesign: Redesign the story screen to use a stage layout to showcase introductory pet story elements cleanly. (why: Layout upgrades on initial path steps yielded significant conversion improvements, while story dwell time remains high.)
1: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Two Column Layout: Change the pick_friend screen layout to a two-column layout separating options from pet details. (why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and a high mean time of 1017s, requiring a clearer presentation.)
2: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Split Layout: Update the choose_path screen layout to split layout to compare choice options side-by-side. (why: Layout changes on path selection stages proved to be the most effective lever for conversion.)
3: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Centered Layout Redesign: Redesign the home_intro screen layout to centered layout to focus attention on pet activation. (why: Finish stage drops to 64.8% conversion and users express confusion about post-spawn interaction.)
4: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Spotlight Redesign: Redesign the adoption_certificate screen into a spotlight layout focusing on the official confirmation. (why: Adoption stage is a major drop-off point (60.9% conversion) with long completion times.)
5: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Two Column Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen layout to a two-column view separating status updates from waiting information. (why: The waiting stage takes median 201s / mean 2336s and accounts for several custom pet creation support reports.)
6: [sign_in, layout] Sign In Centered Layout: Switch the sign_in screen layout to centered layout to simplify authentication focus. (why: Sign in conversion is 72.9% and suffers from 8 support emails regarding account pet sync issues.)
7: [adoption, layout] Upload Photos Carousel Layout: Update the upload_photos screen to use a carousel layout for step-by-step photo selection. (why: Custom pet generation failure and display bugs reported in support suggest photo upload friction.)
8: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Carousel Layout: Change the story screen layout to carousel to allow smooth visual swiping through app concepts. (why: The choose_path stage has a high mean time (514s); layout optimizations on early screens boost momentum.)
9: [finish, hint] Desktop Pet Control Quick Hint: Add a clear hint on the home_intro screen explaining how to access desktop pet controls after setup. (why: Support mails highlight post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)

scores.note: Path selection layout changes have proven effective at improving conversion.
Adoption stage has major drop-off, but layout changes show uncertain results.
Layout optimizations on path selection steps are the most reliable positive lever.
Finish stage redesigns significantly hurt conversion in historical tests.
Redesigns of adoption flows consistently hurt or fail to improve conversion.
Redesigns tend to hurt conversion despite high stage drop-off or dwell time.
Sign-in layout changes previously yielded mild positive conversion lift.
Photo guidance and non-path layout tweaks historically showed no clear effect.
Carousel layout on early path step leverages proven success of path selection layout changes.
Adding hints during onboarding historically hurt conversion.
